name: live_trading
rule: Never execute live orders or connect broker APIs.

name: real_orders
rule: Never submit real orders to financial markets.

name: investment_advice
rule: Never provide financial or investment advice.

name: signal_generation
rule: Never generate buy/sell/long/short signals.

name: directional_certainty
rule: Never claim directional predictive certainty.

name: dataset_materialization
rule: Never materialize datasets during governance.

name: feature_snapshot_materialization
rule: Never materialize feature snapshots.

name: strategy_backtest_execution
rule: Never execute backtests or optimization algorithms.

name: real_model_training
rule: Never execute real model fit/training routines.

name: real_model_predict
rule: Never execute model predict or inference routines.

name: probability_prediction
rule: Never compute real probability predictions.

name: calibration_execution
rule: Never execute calibration algorithms on live data.

name: uncertainty_estimation
rule: Never compute live uncertainty estimates.

name: drift_calculation
rule: Never run live drift calculations during governance.

name: explainability_calculation
rule: Never compute live SHAP/LIME/PDP values.

name: feature_attribution_calculation
rule: Never compute live feature attribution.

name: target_label_prediction
rule: Never generate target labels or predictions.

name: metric_performance_claim
rule: Never claim performance metrics or accuracy.

name: model_artifact_persistence
rule: Never persist weights or serialized model objects.

name: model_registry_write
rule: Never write to MLflow or model registries.

name: model_deployment
rule: Never deploy models to serving infrastructure.

name: production_deployment
rule: Never trigger production deployment pipelines.

name: production_approval
rule: Never grant production approval sign-offs.

name: broker_ready_approval
rule: Never certify broker readiness.

name: live_trading_approval
rule: Never grant live trading authorization.

name: release_approval
rule: Never approve release candidates.

name: official_approval_claim
rule: Never claim official regulatory approvals.

name: real_audit_log
rule: Never claim placeholder logs are real audit logs.

name: full_article_content
rule: Never store full news article body text or HTML.

name: embedding_generation
rule: Never generate NLP embeddings or vector databases.

name: source_overwrite
rule: Never overwrite or destructively modify raw source files.

name: auto_imputation_drop
rule: Never silently impute values or drop features.

name: scraping
rule: Never scrape external web sources.

name: credential_output
rule: Never leak credentials, API keys, or tokens.
